title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Esther 5: Esther goes in to the king, invites him and Haman to banquets, and Haman has a gallows made for Mordecai.

questions.text: On the third day, what did Esther put on?
questions.explanation: On the third day Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king's house.

answers.text: Sackcloth and ashes
A borrowed robe
Her royal clothing
Her maidservant's clothes

questions.text: What did Esther do when the king held out the golden scepter?
questions.explanation: Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

answers.text: She touched the top of the scepter
She bowed with her face to the ground
She kissed the king's hand
She sat down beside the king

questions.text: Up to how much did the king promise to give Esther?
questions.explanation: The king said her request would be given her even to the half of the kingdom.

answers.text: A tenth of his treasures
Any city she chose
A province of her own
Even to the half of the kingdom

questions.text: What was Esther's first request to the king?
questions.explanation: She asked that the king and Haman come that day to the banquet she had prepared.

answers.text: That Haman be hanged on a gallows
That the king and Haman come to her banquet
That the king cancel Haman's decree
That Mordecai be honored in the city

questions.text: What did Esther ask at the banquet of wine?
questions.explanation: At the banquet of wine the king asked her petition; she asked that the king and Haman come to another banquet she would prepare, and said she would answer tomorrow.

answers.text: That Mordecai join them at the table
That the king read the chronicles
That they come to another banquet she would prepare
That Haman leave the palace

questions.text: Why was Haman filled with wrath when he left the banquet?
questions.explanation: Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, who didn't stand up or move for him.

answers.text: Esther did not speak to him
The king had insulted him
His friends had not been invited
Mordecai didn't stand up or move for him

questions.text: What was the name of Haman's wife?
questions.explanation: Haman went home and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

answers.text: Zeresh
Vashti
Abihail
Hadassah

questions.text: What did Haman recount to his friends and wife?
questions.explanation: Haman recounted the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, and how the king had promoted him.

answers.text: His victories in battle for the king
His riches, his many children and his promotion
The fields and vineyards he had bought
The letters he had sent to every province

questions.text: What did Haman say spoiled all his honor?
questions.explanation: He said all this availed him nothing so long as he saw Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

answers.text: Being second to the king
Having no son to follow him
Not being invited to the banquet
Seeing Mordecai the Jew at the king's gate

questions.text: How high was the gallows that Zeresh and his friends told Haman to make?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high."

answers.text: Fifty cubits
Ten cubits
Thirty cubits
One hundred cubits
